name: Doublage vocal
description: Dubs the selected clip: its speech (subtitle track or transcript) is translated and re-spoken by a Voicebox voice, fitted to the original timing (speed change of at most 15 %, or a shorter rewording), and laid on a new audio track while the original voice is lowered. Voicebox (local) is started if needed; the voice list comes from it. Save the project first. Needs ffmpeg; programs run with your user's permissions.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Doubler en anglais
entries.description: Selected clip: translate to English, speak it with the remembered Voicebox voice (asked once), new track « Doublage EN », original voice lowered.

entries.label: Doubler en anglais avec ma voix
entries.description: Same, with your own cloned voice profile in Voicebox (a profile named « Madson », or the one you pick once).

entries.label: Doubler en français
entries.description: Selected clip: translate to French and speak it with the remembered Voicebox voice.

entries.label: Choisir la voix de doublage…
entries.description: Starts Voicebox if needed, lists its voice profiles and remembers the one you pick for English dubs.
